# CFML directory action controls

The short controls are synthetic and are never executed. They check action
routing, attribute order, aliases, interpolation, complete values, comments,
quoted source, malformed attributes, wrong fields/calls, and bare request-like
text versus real request interpolation.

`retained-original.cfm` is the independently decoded original devshell template
from encrypted specimen c28894e4ab24d142a072fdbfddde4dfbfcaba9bfc741a00e935e596ac8c2b3d3.
Decoded SHA-256: 110db2340e0aecb5c59d73b15617b28999d941f974ae04acf4d53ddcf945e9dc.
This is malicious source retained solely for static regression testing. The
runner asserts its digest and directory creation/listing plus hostile findings.
Never run the CFML or contact its network endpoints.

References:
- https://guides.adobe.com/coldfusion/en/docs/cfml-reference/__references__/cfdirectory.html
